exposure: Black, Latine, and White birthing people
cohort: Singleton live births in Louisiana from 2016-2022
finding: Sexual orientation-related disparities in obstetric and perinatal outcomes exist across and within racial/ethnic groups, highlighting the need for an intersectional approach to address these inequities.
mod_finding: Individuals in same-sex relationships were less likely to have spontaneous labor compared with persons in different-sex relationships.
